main_measure.name: mean forward 10-bar return minus coin mean, forecast >= 10
main_measure.threshold: mean excess 10-bar return > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm, < 0 with t <= -2 to reject, at least 30 non-overlapping cases with forecast >= 10

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation forecast vs forward 10-bar excess return, trending bars

decided_by: With at least 30 non-overlapping cases, t lies between -2 and 2 (or sign and t disagree), meeting neither confirm nor reject.
reading: The situation is checked as regime == 'trending' with raw range position > 0 and a long forecast; the coin's mean is its mean forward 10-bar return over all bars of all its windows; the reported value is the mean over all bars with forecast >= 10, while the t-statistic and the case count use the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window).
